# Excel Electrics – Wire & Fire

> Excel Electrics is a NICEIC approved electrical contractor (Excel Fire Ltd, trading as Excel Electrics) providing friendly, tidy, clearly priced electrical and fire safety work for homes, landlords and businesses across Essex, Suffolk, Cambridgeshire, Hertfordshire and London.

- Phone: 07730 591822
- Email: info@excelelectrics.com
- Address: 124 City Road, London EC1V 2NX
- Hours: Monday to Friday, 08:00–17:00
- Areas covered: Essex, Suffolk, Cambridgeshire, Hertfordshire, London and Greater London

## Accreditations

- NICEIC (certificates held by Excel Fire Ltd): Approved Contractor Scheme (AC200816), Domestic Installer Scheme (D200842), Periodic Inspection in the Rented Sector (RS200662)
- CHAS, Constructionline Gold, SMAS Worksafe

## Services

- [Electrical work](https://excelelectrics.com/services/electrical-work): fault finding and repairs, new lights and sockets, consumer unit (fuse box) replacements, electrical safety checks (EICRs), Electrical Installation Certificates and rewires.
- [Fire safety](https://excelelectrics.com/services/fire-safety): smoke alarm and heat detector installation, home fire alarm systems, replacing old or faulty alarms.
- [Access & security](https://excelelectrics.com/services/access-security): door entry systems (intercoms, video entry, keypads and fobs), access control for homes and flats, repairs and upgrades.
- [Gates, garage doors & bollards](https://excelelectrics.com/services/gates-garage-bollards): electric gate installations, automated garage doors, converting manual systems to electric, repairs and servicing.
- [EV charging](https://excelelectrics.com/services/ev-charging): home EV charger installation, repairs and upgrades, load checks and smart charging advice.

## Projects

- [St Marylebone Almshouses, St John's Wood](https://excelelectrics.com/projects/st-marylebone-almshouses): Paxton Net2 access control, Cat5e cabling, video door entry for residents and new electric gates, for Woodnut Construction (2026).
- [BP forecourt, Ipswich](https://excelelectrics.com/projects/bp-forecourt-ipswich): canopy lighting fault traced, repaired, tested and commissioned by scissor lift while the forecourt kept trading (2026).
- [Emirates Stadium, London](https://excelelectrics.com/projects/emirates-stadium): maglocks, hold-open devices and strike plates on new fire doorsets, all interlinked with the stadium fire alarm, for CBRE (2025–2026).
